brand_positioning: Homeownership Operating System (not merely a mortgage calculator)

systems_thinking_framework.philosophy: Non-linear systems dynamics over linear sequence. Evaluates stocks, flows, delays, bottlenecks, feedback loops, and mental models.

iceberg_model.level_1_event: Surface-level market announcement or policy change
iceberg_model.level_2_pattern: Historical behavioural trends and price/volume trajectories over time
iceberg_model.level_3_structure: Regulatory architectures, Central Bank macroprudential rules, tax codes, and planning systems
iceberg_model.level_4_mental_model: Underlying consumer and lender beliefs (e.g. 'mortgage-ready equals homeownership-ready')

strategic_dimensions.name: Financial Confidence
strategic_dimensions.objective: Information that helps prospective buyers clearly understand their financial position, deposit readiness, borrowing boundaries, and stress tolerance.

strategic_dimensions.name: Decision Intelligence
strategic_dimensions.objective: Information that empowers buyers to make better, well-timed homeownership decisions (location, property type, scheme trade-offs, loan structures).

strategic_dimensions.name: Reduced Uncertainty
strategic_dimensions.objective: Information that cuts through unknowns, confusing legal jargon, hidden conveyancing/survey costs, and bureaucratic ambiguity.

strategic_dimensions.name: Financial Outcomes
strategic_dimensions.objective: Information that leads to measurable financial improvement: maximizing tax reliefs (HTB), avoiding overpaying on interest/rates, or optimizing grant claims.

strategic_dimensions.name: Homeownership Journey
strategic_dimensions.objective: Information supporting the emotional and practical trajectory from aspiration to mortgage-readiness, bidding, approval, drawdown, and long-term ownership.

active_campaign_themes.title: Understanding Your True Borrowing Capacity
active_campaign_themes.focus: Macroprudential rules, income multiples, exemptions, and stress testing.

active_campaign_themes.title: The Real Cost of Buying a Home
active_campaign_themes.focus: Beyond the deposit: legal fees, stamp duty, valuation, structural surveys, local property tax, and furnishing.

active_campaign_themes.title: Preparing Financially for Homeownership
active_campaign_themes.focus: Savings habits, clearing high-interest debt, rent-as-proof-of-repayment, and credit profile hygiene.

active_campaign_themes.title: Understanding the Irish Property Market
active_campaign_themes.focus: Asking vs. sold price gaps (PPR vs. Daft), bidding dynamics, regional supply constraints, and new phase releases.

active_campaign_themes.title: First-Time Buyer Financial Readiness
active_campaign_themes.focus: Help to Buy (HTB), First Home Scheme (equity share), Local Authority Home Loans, and navigating eligibility shifts.

active_campaign_themes.title: Making Better Decisions Before Committing to a Mortgage
active_campaign_themes.focus: Fixed vs. variable rates, green mortgages, BER ratings, energy retrofit costs, and long-term flexibility.

active_campaign_themes.title: Mortgage-Ready vs. Homeownership-Ready
active_campaign_themes.focus: Getting bank approval is step one; holding sufficient emergency funds, buffer reserves, and life stage alignment is true ownership readiness.

ten_strategic_questions: What customer problem does it relate to?
